alpine.label: Alpine Linux 3.24
alpine.description: Lightweight Linux distribution prepared for an interactive serial console on ttyS0. The root and toto accounts are available; the RAW image is read-only and each VM uses its own working disk.
alpine.login: root with no password; toto / toto

debian13.label: Debian 13
debian13.description: Debian 13 prepared offline from the official cloud image. It boots from disk with GRUB, displays boot output and login on ttyS0, and provides root, toto and demo accounts.
debian13.login: root with no password; toto / toto; demo / serial-demo

openwrt.label: OpenWrt 25.12 x86-64
openwrt.description: Lightweight network-oriented Linux system running in text mode on the serial console. The demo profile disables network adapters; its RAW base comes from the official disk image.
openwrt.login: Press Enter, then root with no password
